rows.en:
(I wonder if she acts like that
around boys too~)
rows.notes: Female only; end of the swimming scene.

rows.en: Heading home, Akimizu?

...Yes... I suppose I am...
Are you heading home by yourself?
Really and truly?

But I... won't lose...
I'm the one who's going to win in the end!
Are you heading home now?
Wh-why would I lie about that?

What's gotten into you, Yuu...?
Tell you? ...Not really... nothing? Probably...
Hey, Akimizu~!

Oh... \p-kun.
Hello.
Ehehe... I'm a little short on cash today...
Oh no, I couldn't...
rows.notes: Both genders; declining the player's offer to treat her.

rows.en: I'm hungry too, so don't worry about it.
C'mon, let's go, let's go!
H-hey, don't push~
Let's keep 'em coming!
I feel kind of bad about this...

Excuse meee!
Six servings of maguro buns!!

...W-well, that's because you ordered so much...
And leaving food would be rude to the shop...
rows.notes: Both genders; answers 'You really put it away, huh?'.

rows.en: ...I might've left it at home...

Did you look properly?
Your pockets, your bag...
Ahahahaha... It's not there...
Th-thank you very much...
rows.notes: Both genders; Akimizu working as a waitress.

rows.en: J-just a moment, please...

Oh, no. It was nice exercise after the meal...
And I got to wear a Nyan-Nyan outfit, too...
O-oh, come on, you're just saying that...
...Hehe... Thank you.
Yes, let's.
rows.notes: Both genders; answers 'shall we head home?'.

rows.en: Hey, Yuu~!

Oh... \p-chan.
Hello.
Then I'll treat you.
I'm hungry too, hehe.
Sorry for getting you into this mess...

I hear you've gotten close to that guy lately...?
I heard the rumors.
rows.notes: ext_yuu_005, both genders; patterned on c02372 ('that girl'). 'Ano otoko no hito' unnamed.

rows.en: (Looks like Alto's up on the roof.)

Hey, Alto.
What are you doing out here?
rows.notes: Male; also frd_alt_004 (met outside at night).

rows.en: Hm? Oh, just looking at the sky...
Huh. Can you see something unusual up there?
No...
By the way, about today's Practical Training class...
rows.notes: Both genders; Alto does not answer.

rows.en: (Looks like he's lost in thought...)

...Huh, \p?
What's up? You need something from me?

Nah, I just called out to you to chat a bit,
but you weren't reacting at all, so...
Sorry about that.

Nah, it's not like I needed anything in
particular, so don't worry about it.
Okay. Then that's fine.

But when you keep looking at the sky,
it kind of calms you down, huh.

Yeah.
Even if it's "a sky like this," it's the only sky we've got.
rows.notes: Both genders; Alto's scare quotes kept (the fleet's artificial sky).

rows.en:
I think I kind of get how you feel
when you look at the sky, Alto.
Yeah. The sky isn't as complicated as people.
Haha, true.
You're in the Pilot Course, right?

Yeah, same course as you, Alto.
Don't forget that.
There's something I wanted to ask you...
Hm, what is it?
rows.notes: x3: frd_alt_001 (male player) and Luis in frd_lis_007 (both genders).

rows.en:
Nah, I'll save it for next time.
It's getting late.
Come on, now I'm curious.

Well, guess I'll head home.
It'd be faster if I could just fly there.
Ahaha, no doubt about that.
(Alto really seems to love the sky.)
(Looks like Saotome-kun's up on the roof.)

Saotome-kun,
what are you doing out here?
Huh. Can you see something unusual up there?
(Looks like he's lost in thought...)

Oh, no, I just called out to you to chat a bit,
but you weren't reacting at all, so...

No, it's not like I needed anything either,
so don't worry about it.

But looking at the sky for a while
really does calm you down, doesn't it.

I think I kind of get how you feel when
you look at the sky, Saotome-kun.
Ahaha, that's true.

Yeah, we're in the same course.
Don't forget that.
Hm, what?

Nah, I'll ask you some other time.
It's getting late.
What? Now I'm curious...
Ahaha, that's true enough.
(Saotome-kun really does love the sky.)
(Looks like Alto's up on the roof again...)
Hey, Alto. Here again?
Yeah. Looking at the sky again...
You really love it, huh...

Keeping me company just to look at the sky...
You're a weird one too.
rows.notes: Both genders; the reply 'Yeah, maybe I am.' (c03768/c03774) follows.

uncertain: c03721: 'that guy' (unnamed), patterned on the finished c02372 'that girl'.
c03735: Alto's quoted 'konna sora' kept in double quotes as "a sky like this" (Frontier's artificial sky).
c03765: 'aa, mata sora wo... na...' rendered 'Yeah. Looking at the sky again...'.
